title: MK Ultra purpose: LSD as interrogation truth serum

tellings.quote: that you know if you dose somebody with with LSD it will dissolve away yeah the boundaries yeah uh of their concept structures you know

plain: MK Ultra, a secret US government program of the 1950s and 60s that tested drugs such as LSD on people, was really aimed at turning LSD into a truth serum for interrogations, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan. He explains the thinking without naming a source: if you dose someone with LSD, it dissolves "the boundaries of their concept structures", so the person might no longer hold back what they know. If so, the program's goal was breaking down a prisoner's guard, not mind expansion.
